Retrieved: 2026-07-28 19:41 UTC

The .eml originals stored under /records carry DKIM and ARC signatures
applied by the sending domains. A signature verifies against the public
key the domain published in DNS at the time of signing. Domains rotate
keys, and once a key is rotated or removed, live DNS can no longer
verify older signatures. This file preserves the published keys as
retrieved, so the signatures on the stored originals remain verifiable
against the keys that produced them.

DNS does not publish when a key became effective. For each key, IN USE
gives the dates of the earliest and latest stored messages signed with
that selector and domain; RETRIEVED is when the DNS record was read.
The git history of this file, in the archive's public repository,
records every retrieval and any change in the published keys.
